author: AyeshaJadoon
decision: Research discovery only. Not loaded as current law or a hosted LLM.
findings: Dataset contains extracted legal text, not model weights or a hosted inference API.
Downloaded schema uses text rather than content as in the card example.
PECA record has 29 pages and lacks the current 39-page official consolidation; it is not suitable as a current-law authority.
The linked PakistaniLawPhi-3 is a LoRA adapter requiring a base model. Its card lists no hosted inference provider; no runtime integration was added.
